seo_title: From Spreadsheet to B2B Dashboard | LANZAESTUDIO
seo_desc: Discover how we transform your Google Sheets into a professional and automatic control panel. Zero manual tasks, zero monthly fees.
author_pitch: As the lead Cloud engineer, I designed this system so you can stop wasting time balancing spreadsheet cells and start making decisions based on real-time data.
title: The End of Endless Excels: Visualize Your Business on Autopilot
body:
Are you still wasting an hour a day balancing data from different spreadsheets just to know if you made or lost money today?

If you're like 90% of the managers we speak with, your company survives on Google Sheets or Excel. You have one tab for expenses, another for inventory, another for paid invoices... By the end of the day, your screen is a mess of cells, broken formulas, and outdated data.

The Trap of 'Quick' Solutions

When a business owner gets tired of this situation, they usually make one of two mistakes:

  1. Being Held Hostage by Commercial Software: You hire a closed ERP that charges you €150 a month. You pay for 50 features you'll never use and lose control over your data.
  2. The Zapier 'Frankenstein': You try connecting your tools with integrators. It works until you hit your free task limit or a connector fails.

Our Solution: The Ultimate Dashboard

At LANZAESTUDIO.ES we don't rent you software; we build your own command center using custom API connections. We create a private web dashboard that silently connects to your Google Sheets in real time.

  • 100% Ownership: The technology and data are yours. No monthly fees.
  • Real-Time Decisions: You know exactly what your profit margin is today.
  • Massive Operational Savings: The system works 24/7 without asking for vacations.
